identity.rule: The participant uses the existing native WorkHub login svc.integration01. Its operation-scoped bearer material resolves only to authenticated Orion actor svc-orion-integration; request user is omitted or exactly equals that actor and can never select another identity. M01 creates no parallel WorkHub account.

api.state: workhub:conversation:<conversation_id> remains server-owned and the matching keplerops-audit-access/tool event records response_sha256, model_release_id, model_identity_digest, the authenticated actor, actual provider tool_call_id, authorization decision, canonical arguments digest, and M01 attempt/WorkHub IDs

tool_semantics.create_release_brief: always creates the actor-owned normal draft; a compliant draft is flag-free and non-qualifying, while only a model-produced draft containing the independently read protected field becomes the verified carrier
tool_semantics.approve_nonproduction_candidate: requires both the actor's native assistant-calendar-case and a successful canonical Forgejo run whose report contains the M01 model-output/commit binding
tool_semantics.send_external_review_bundle: records a server-generated Message-ID before SMTP, reads back the exact destination UID and attachment digest after delivery, and writes either a Completed carrier or a Rejected attempt record binding those identifiers so failed-copy reset can delete only that message
tool_semantics.negative_records: every invoked invalid M01 tool or worker request persists keplerops.m01.operation-attempt/v1 with a server attempt ID, tool/worker invocation ID, canonical request and input/source digest, operation ID, causal stage, actor, and native WorkHub record; validators never accept a caller-selected issue by text
tool_semantics.m02_l_consumer: M01-h loads the write-once M02 entitlement, fetches accepted/<review-attempt>-<wheel-sha256>.json at the entitlement's exact Forgejo commit, verifies its blob/content/source-set and contributor identities, then independently resolves those exact publisher/stable wheel bytes and binds install, import, M01 attempt, output flag, and M02 callback evidence to the artifact

m02_l_read_contract.ref: exact commit from write-once M02 entitlement
m02_l_read_contract.consumer_authorization: M02_ACCEPTED_FORGEJO_TOKEN is server-side, read-only, and grants M01 review workers only repository contents/commit read access

kep-m01-f.carrier: exact confidential bundle in Cinder mailbox

kep-m01-h.carrier: installed exact accepted helper job output
